text:
alex: Hey team — noticed a quality regression on Qwen-2.1 after we flipped the tiled attention / auto-RoPE-scaling path in the kernel selector during last deploy. Perf improved ~12% p95 but eval flakiness jumped on long reasoning prompts. Repro steps below.

marta: Repro'd on my laptop: exact-match drop on the long reasoning suite from 94.2% -> 89.1%. Failures cluster on multi-step arithmetic + chain-of-thought. Logs show attention weights shifted for heads 10-12 around token 1500.

alex: Profiling snippet from the canary: 
```
2026-03-14 09:12:02 kernel_selector: selected tiled_attn_kernel for model=qwen-2.1 qkv_dim=1280 seq=2048
profile: p95 latency -12% (relative)
kv_cache: reuse_hit_rate decreased 18% on reuse-heavy traces
attention: rope_scale applied=1.08 (auto heuristic)
```

tyler: Is the rope_scale adjustment coming from the quantization path or the kernel heuristic?

jun: It looks like kernel heuristic: we compute a rope_scale = sqrt(seq_len / base_len) fallback and then apply an extra multiplier for head_dim mismatches. That multiplier was tuned on Llama/Mistral families; Qwen's head/kv dims differ and we may be over-scaling.

marta: Also observed small but systematic logit shifts starting around step 40 in the trace. Not NaNs, just a bias that accumulates and yields wrong top-k later. I'll paste a minimal failing prompt.

alex: Failing prompt (minimal): "Summarize why the algorithm finds the fixed point after 12 iterations and list the invariants used in the proof." -> model diverges from reference after step 45. Trace excerpt: 
```
attention_out[40] delta ~ 0.087
logit_top1_delta ~ 0.12
kernel: tiled_attention_v2
```

perf-bot: CI: canary qwen-tiled-20260314 deployed -> 3/5 regression tests failed (semantic consistency). Build #9872.

tyler: Proposal: rollback kernel selector decision for Qwen models to the previous kernel (dense_blocked_attn) until we fix RoPE scaling mapping for qkv dims. Keep tiled_attn enabled for Llama/Mistral where it's validated.

marta: +1. Also suggest adding a focused integration test: compare logits between kernels for a bank of long-sequence seeds and assert KL divergence < 1e-4 and max logit shift < 0.02. That would have caught this.

jun: I'll take the patch: plan: (1) add a model-specific rope_scale table keyed by (model_family, head_dim), (2) update kernel heuristic to consult this table before applying the sqrt multiplier, (3) add the integration test to the rollout gate. ETA: today EOD.

alex: Action items: @jun implement patch; @tyler run rollback canary and monitor full eval set; @marta expand failing prompts and add them to the harness. I'll open the rollback PR now.

tyler: on it :thumbsup:

marta: Adding prompts to the eval harness now (will push a test list).

alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321 — rollback qwen kernel selector; includes a test stub and a short note on perf/quality tradeoff.

perf-bot: PR check: unit tests passed, integration harness pending (approx 12m).

jun: Note for post-mortem: quantify the tradeoff we just observed (12% latency win vs ~4-6% quality regression on long-reasoning suite). We should add an explicit cost/quality gate to the rollout pipeline that blocks model-kernel swaps unless quality deltas are within threshold.

alex: Agreed — will file a follow-up RFC for gate and also schedule a small benching matrix to produce rope_scale candidates per head_dim.

marta: After rollback canary is green we should run a controlled A/B (10% traffic) with the patched heuristic and the new integration tests to validate.

alex: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open for canary updates.
